questions.question: By how much did the World Bank Group cut its average project-approval time?
questions.expected_answer: From 19 months to nine months; some low-risk projects were approved in as little as 60 days.
questions.evidence_quote: We cut average project-approval times from 19 months to nine, with some low-risk projects approved in as little as 60 days.

questions.question: How much did the World Bank Group issue in guarantees in fiscal 2026, and how does that compare with its 2030 goal?
questions.expected_answer: $25 billion, surpassing the goal of issuing $20 billion annually by 2030.

questions.question: How large is the gap between the number of young people entering working age and the jobs developing countries are expected to create?
questions.expected_answer: About 1.2 billion young people reach working age in the next 10-15 years, while developing countries are expected to generate only about 420 million jobs in that period.
questions.evidence_quote: With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the next 10 to 15 years, the need for more and better-paid jobs is more urgent than ever. On current trajectories, developing countries are expected to generate only about 420 million jobs over that same period
